limitations: Degree-two primitive idempotent only; no rates for joint limits or higher-degree idempotents. The Poisson threshold concerns a limiting profile, not finite-system phase transitions. Equivalent identities in older orthogonal-polynomial literature remain a named originality risk.
scientific_integrity: The finite endpoint-norm identity follows exactly from tensor projection kernels and a signed binomial second-difference identity. The Gaussian and Poisson crossover limits follow from central and Poisson limit theorems with explicit fourth-moment uniform integrability; finite computations corroborate but cannot prove infinite limits. This package makes no independent-certification claim.
title: Exact degree-two Hamming projection norms and the Gaussian–Poisson crossover
